title: Welcome and product introduction
description: The first-run introduction explains the small trusted circle and optional check-ins.
steps: Open My Pod for the first time

title: What sharing means
description: The lower welcome screen explains approved people and clearly identifies the sample experience.
steps: Scroll to the introduction and primary action

title: Family pod overview
description: The main dashboard shows the family, an outstanding sample alert, and recent evidence.

title: All four sample people
description: Scroll continuation includes Paati with an activity gap and Kavin with unavailable human-activity status.

title: Choose a pod
description: Family, Friends and Work are separate circles in the local preview.

title: Friends pod empty state
description: An empty circle provides a clear invitation action.

title: Work pod empty state
description: The work circle uses the same consent-based invitation entry point.

title: Amma — phone activity
description: Recent sample phone interaction, with its original observation age.

title: Appa — movement
description: Movement-based reassurance is labelled as movement, not an unlock. This is an Android rendering of sample iPhone evidence, not an iOS screenshot.

title: Contact actions and evidence explanation
description: Scroll continuation explains the limits of movement evidence and exposes check-in/call actions.
steps: Scroll to the explanation and contact actions

title: Quick check-in message preview
description: The dialog states that this sample action has not sent a message.
steps: Choose Ask if everything is okay

title: Call action preview
description: The sample contact has no real number. No phone call is placed.

title: Paati — activity gap
description: An activity gap prompts a check-in; it does not claim that an emergency has occurred.

title: Kavin — unavailable
description: Device connectivity alone does not establish human activity. The status remains unavailable.

title: Invite someone into your pod
description: An invitation does not grant access: the recipient chooses whether to join and share.

title: Invitation validation
description: A missing name produces an inline validation message.

title: Personalised invitation preview
description: A sample invitation is prepared locally. No invitation link or message is sent.

title: Updates with an open check-in
description: The activity timeline distinguishes an unresolved check-in from routine evidence.

title: Check-in needs attention
description: Only approved sample responders appear. An activity gap is described conservatively.

title: Approved responder plan
description: Scroll continuation shows the primary responder, approved backup and local-demo boundary.

title: Responder acknowledges follow-up
description: Acknowledgement records ownership but keeps the check-in open until an outcome is recorded.
steps: Choose I am checking on Paati

title: Contact outcome recorded
description: The person following up records a sample conversation and closes this local incident.

title: Updates after resolution
description: The timeline now reflects the recorded outcome rather than an unresolved alert.

title: Privacy preferences by default
description: Passive sharing is a preview. Optional explicit check-ins and city sharing start off.

title: Sharing paused
description: A deliberate pause is visible; it is not confused with an activity gap.

title: Explicit check-ins enabled optionally
description: An explicit confirmation can be added without becoming compulsory for every user.

title: City sharing preference
description: The local preference is city-level sharing, not a route or exact address. No location permission is requested in this build.

title: Approved people and privacy actions
description: Scroll continuation lists sample approved people and exposes privacy information and reset.

title: Activity and privacy explanation
description: The dialog explains platform limits and that sensors, accounts and remote notifications are not connected.

title: Restart preview confirmation
description: Reset requires an explicit choice, with an option to keep preferences.

title: Larger text and single-column people
description: At 1.4-times text size, the people layout switches to a roomier single column.

title: Single-column people tiles
description: Scroll continuation shows the larger-text people layout without squeezing two cards together.

title: Larger-text evidence details
description: Identity, evidence and device metrics remain scrollable; the metrics stack vertically.

title: Larger-text privacy controls
description: The preference controls remain reachable with larger text.
